effect_description_eng: [Start of Your Main Phase] By trashing 1 Digimon card with [Avian], [Bird], [Beast], [Animal] or [Sovereign] in any of its traits (other than [Sea Animal]) in your hand, reveal the top 4 cards of your deck. Add 1 red card among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When a card is removed from your opponent's security stack, gain 1 memory.
